Time-dependent CD and UV–vis tests (in the Supplementary Fig. S6, which isn't part of this document) showed the BA@L-HGNRs made with[2] 165 μM 4-MPBA-derived BA@L-HGNRs showing exceptional spectral stability during the entire monitoring process[3].
